notes.title: Planned Updates
notes.content:
Happy Lunar New Year!

While the studio is working on a much bigger upcoming project for announcement in 2024, we will still be updating Hook Line and Sinker based on community feedbacks on top of adding Achievements and tweaks to gameplay.

So with that in mind, here is a quick update on what is being worked on:

- Improved Tutorials
- Streamlined Casual mode (Improved accessbility for Teeth Farming)
- Achievements
- Checkpoint system
- Additional Sub Weapon (Sinker)
- Improvements to current weapons, to start with Blade

Wishing everyone a great holiday and a properous year ahead!

notes.title: Modern Controls Update
notes.content:
We are aware that the modern controls feels clunky and can be further improved, so this update should make dodging boss attacks and fishing alot easier! Especially for those who are on controllers.

Do Master the Hook Dash as it is still better than a quick turn!
